name: fuzzy_bench_noisy_v2
description: A dataset intended to evaluate model robustness to noisy / fuzzy input variants (noisy version of a fuzzy-matching benchmark). It provides perturbed text examples to measure how model performance degrades under realistic input corruptions. The benchmark focuses on robustness of text understanding and matching.
reputation: Niche robustness benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in robustness evaluations.
